description: Ingest a single analytics event into the Mixpanel event stream.

event.description: The name of the event to track (required).

distinct_id.description: Optional distinct id of the user; defaults to 'anonymous' when omitted.

time.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the event; defaults to now when omitted.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds status (1) and the generated event_id; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Return per-day counts for events, optionally filtered by event name(s) and date range.

event.description: Optional comma-separated list of event names to include; all events when omitted.

from_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

to_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a data object with series (days) and values (per-event per-day counts) plus legend_size.

description: List all available funnels with their id and name.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of funnel objects (funnel_id, name).

description: Get a single funnel by id with step-by-step and overall conversion ratios.

funnel_id.description: The unique id of the funnel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the funnel object with steps and analysis; on failure (funnel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Return per-day counts for a single event, optionally segmented by a property.

from_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

to_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

on.description: Optional property name to segment the event counts by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a data object with series (days) and values (per-segment per-day counts); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Query user profiles, optionally filtered by distinct id or a simple property expression.

distinct_id.description: Optional distinct id to fetch a single profile.

where.description: Optional simple filter expression of the form 'property==value'.

page_size.description: Maximum number of profiles to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds results (list of profiles), page, page_size, and total.
